facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 50°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: The nearby stations disagree about this year: snow left Wells Creek (4,040 ft) 26 days earlier, Easy Pass (5,280 ft) 4 days earlier and Marten Ridge (3,520 ft) 24 days earlier than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: left May 11; earlier seasons: June 3 (2023), June 9 (2024), June 6 (2025)

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: left June 30; earlier seasons: June 27 (2023), July 8 (2024), July 4 (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 17; earlier seasons: June 12 (2023), June 8 (2024), June 10 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Easy Pass (5,280 ft) and the lowest at Wells Creek (4,040 ft) and Marten Ridge (3,520 ft).

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: 17.5 in on April 4; earlier seasons: 37.5 in (2023), 24.0 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: 95.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 89.3 in (2023), 71.0 in (2024), 87.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: 23.2 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 59.8 in (2023), 32.0 in (2024), 46.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 14 and July 25, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Wells Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 11, 1,367 ft below the pass; points to May 3 to July 6

evidence.name: Easy Pass
evidence.detail: melted out June 30, 127 ft below the pass; points to June 10 to July 25

evidence.name: Marten Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 17, 1,887 ft below the pass; points to May 14 to July 25
